svg.title: table-hmiDisplayNeedValidationView
svg.desc: table-hmiDisplayNeedValidationView. Generated from SysIDE grid CSV.

text.tspan: Plan
Review
hmiSceneValidationPlan
For NEED-HMI-001, a planned stakeholder
review. While the warning scenarios and
the no-reaction scenarios of the driver-
assistance increment run on the display
(SC-HMI-001 and SC-HMI-002), can
verification engineers and systems
engineers confirm whether the lane, the
path, the objects with their level and the
closest object in the path with its
distance and its speed that the display
shows are those that the driver-assistance
system gave, whether the display marked
the closest object in the path apart from
the other objects, and whether the display
showed any object that the system did not
give, from the simulator's record of the
scene or from an estimate of the display's
own? Can systems engineers and safety
experts tell which items cross into the
HMI display from outside its boundary, the
lane of the driver-assistance system, the
path it fits to that lane, the objects it
detects with their level relative to its
path, the closest object in its path with
the distance and the speed that its fusion
gives, the vehicle speed that the system
is given and its warning request, and
whether each reaches the display as its
source gives it? And can product-line
engineers tell which content of the HMI
display is common to the member products
and which derives from a member's driving
application?
hmiSpeedValidationPlan
For NEED-HMI-002, a planned stakeholder
review. While the warning scenarios and
the no-reaction scenarios of the driver-
assistance increment run on the display
(SC-HMI-001 and SC-HMI-002), can
verification engineers and systems
engineers confirm whether the speed that
the display shows is the vehicle speed
that the driver-assistance system was
given, and whether any other source of the
speed reached the display?
hmiWarningValidationPlan
For NEED-HMI-003, a planned stakeholder
review. While the warning scenarios and
the no-reaction scenarios of the driver-
assistance increment run on the display
(SC-HMI-001 and SC-HMI-002), can
verification engineers and safety experts
confirm whether the display gave the
collision warning on the display and as a
sound for each warning request of the
driver-assistance system, whether it gave
one without a request, and when each mode
began relative to the request, with no
recording or overlay in place of either
mode? And can safety experts and systems
engineers follow the sequence from the
warning request of the driver-assistance
system to the collision warning on the
display and to its sound, and the time of
each step within the time that the driver-
assistance increment allots from the
request to each mode, independent of the
elements that realize it?
hmiOutageValidationPlan
For NEED-HMI-004, a planned stakeholder
review. While the app that draws the scene
is out and while Android in the IVI VM
boots, hangs and restarts (SC-HMI-003 to
SC-HMI-006), can verification engineers
and safety experts confirm whether the
driver saw the vehicle speed throughout
and got the collision warning for each
warning request, or, where the warning
could not be given, saw that it was
unavailable? Can safety experts and
systems engineers follow the sequence from
each outage of the drawing of the scene
and of the environment that hosts it, the
drawing hanging or ending and its host
hanging, booting or restarting, to its
detection and to what the display shows
then, independent of the elements that
realize it? Can product-line engineers and
safety experts tell which renderer
realizes the drawing of each element of
the HMI display, and whether the split
that the owner decided on 2026-11-17, the
high availability renderer in an SDV Media
VM for the speed, the collision warning
and its sound and an app in the IVI VM for
the scene, keeps what the driver sees
while Android in the IVI VM hangs, boots
or restarts? And can system architects and
systems engineers tell which elements
exchange each input of the HMI display on
its way from the SDV Core VM to the high
availability renderer in the SDV Media VM
and to the app in the IVI VM that draws
the scene, by which exchange that app
tells the renderer that Android is alive,
and by which boundary interface each input
enters the display?
hmiCurrencyValidationPlan
For NEED-HMI-005, a planned stakeholder
review. While the app that draws the scene
is out, while Android in the IVI VM boots,
hangs and restarts, and while the warning
request stops reaching the display (SC-
HMI-003 to SC-HMI-007), can safety experts
and verification engineers tell the states
that each element of the HMI display can
be in, current, late or missing, and the
state in which the collision warning is
unavailable, what the display shows in
each, and whether the display showed any
element as current when it was not, or the
warning as available when it could not be
given?
hmiDisplayIdentityValidationPlan
For NEED-HMI-006, a planned stakeholder
review. While the seven scenarios run (SC-
HMI-001 to SC-HMI-007), can verification
engineers and product-line engineers tell
from each run which build and which
configuration of the HMI display ran and
which candidate revision the run of the
driver-assistance system identifies,
whether each verdict is bound to them, and
whether a display with a changed build or
setting identifies itself as a different
one?
